object.attr: derived: written with the security fix, from the requirement and the code view's finding.
object.description: Without MELLON_DRAWIO, put a draw.io program in the current folder, which is the repository; separately, in a folder inside the repository that PATH names, in a folder PATH names by a relative path, and (Windows) in a standard install folder that lies inside the repository; then in a PATH folder outside the repository; then name the program inside the repository in MELLON_DRAWIO. Expected: the programs in the current folder and inside the repository are never found; the one outside is found; the one MELLON_DRAWIO names is used.
